name: Mi yang
source:
"Where... am I?" A girl searches for a way out, but finds only monsters and madness. The horrors push her to the edge, whispering, Run!

[From [url=https://game-beacon.itch.io/lostlamb]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“我……在哪里？”一个女孩寻找出路，却发现只有怪物和疯狂。恐惧将她推向边缘，低声说：快跑！

[来自[url=https://game-beacon.itch.io/lostlamb]Itch.io[/url]]
